content:
Overview

České Budějovice is a city in South Bohemia with a population of 94,000. The capital of South Bohemia, home to Budweiser Budvar brewery, a stunning main square, and a gateway to the Šumava region. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
